description: Django views module for e-commerce application, handling product display, checkout, payment processing, cart management, coupons, and refunds.

classes.name: CheckoutView
classes.description: Handles the checkout process, including address selection and payment option selection.

classes.name: PaymentView
classes.description: Manages payment processing via Stripe, including saving customer info and handling errors.

classes.name: HomeView
classes.description: Displays paginated list of items on the home page.

classes.name: OrderSummaryView
classes.description: Shows current user's active order summary.

classes.name: ItemDetailView
classes.description: Displays detailed view of a specific item.

methods.name: products
methods.description: Renders the products page with all items.

methods.name: is_valid_form
methods.description: Checks if form fields are non-empty.
